grammar_tip: 一邊…一邊… (yì biān... yì biān...) expresses doing two actions simultaneously (e.g. chatting while toasting). 道地 (dào dì) means authentic.

translations.en: The most convenient part of living in Taiwan is having a convenience store every few steps; whether sending packages or withdrawing cash, it's super convenient!
translations.es: Lo más práctico de vivir en Taiwán es tener una tienda de conveniencia a pocos pasos; ya sea enviar paquetes o retirar dinero, ¡es súper cómodo!
translations.de: Das Praktischste am Leben in Taiwan ist, dass es alle paar Schritte einen Supermarkt gibt; ob Pakete versenden oder Geld abheben, alles ist extrem bequem!
translations.fr: Le plus pratique à Taïwan, c'est d'avoir un konbini à quelques pas; qu'il s'agisse d'envoyer un colis ou retirer de l'argent, c'est super pratique!
translations.it: La cosa più comoda del vivere a Taiwan è avere un minimarket ogni due passi; che si tratti di spedire pacchi o prelevare contanti, è comodissimo!
translations.ja: 台湾生活で一番便利なのは数歩歩けばコンビニがあることで、荷物の発送でも現金の引き出しでもとても便利です！
translations.ko: 대만 생활에서 가장 편리한 점은 몇 걸음만 걸으면 편의점이 있다는 것이며, 택배를 보내든 돈을 찾든 정말 편리합니다!

grammar_tip: Taiwan High Speed Rail (台灣高鐵 / THSR) connects Taiwan's west coast corridor at speeds up to 300 km/h.

en_full: When taking public buses in Taipei and New Taipei City nowadays, tap your EasyCard both when boarding and alighting.
grammar_tip: 雙北 (shuāng běi) refers to Taipei City and New Taipei City. Bus rides require tapping upon boarding and alighting (上下車刷卡).

en_full: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'

hanzi: 台灣朋友熱情地對我說：「有空常來家裡坐坐！」
pinyin: Tái wān péng yǒu rè qíng de duì wǒ shuō: 'Yǒu kòng cháng lái jiā lǐ zuò zuò!'
zhuyin: ㄊㄞˊ ㄨㄢ ㄆㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄖㄜˋ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄕㄨㄛ：ㄧㄡˇ ㄎㄨㄥˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄌㄞˊ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄗㄨㄛ˙！
tr_full: Tayvanlı arkadaşım bana sıcak bir şekilde: 'Vaktin olunca sık sık eve oturmaya gel!' dedi.
en_full: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'
grammar_tip: 有空來坐坐 (yǒu kòng lái zuò zuò = come sit whenever you have time) expresses classic Taiwanese hospitality.

translations.ja: 話す

translations.tr: Tayvanlı arkadaşım bana sıcak bir şekilde: 'Vaktin olunca sık sık eve oturmaya gel!' dedi.
translations.en: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'
translations.es: Mi amigo taiwanés me dijo amablemente: '¡Cuando tengas tiempo, pásate por mi casa!'
translations.de: Mein taiwanesischer Freund sagte herzlich: 'Komm vorbei, wenn du Zeit hast!'
translations.fr: Mon ami taïwanais m'a dit chaleureusement : 'Passe à la maison dès que tu as du temps !'
translations.it: Il mio amico taiwanese mi ha detto con calore: 'Quando hai tempo, vieni a trovarmi a casa!'
translations.ja: 台湾の友人が『時間があればいつでも家に遊びに来てね！』と温かく言ってくれました。
translations.ko: 대만인 친구가 '시간 될 때 언제든 집에 놀러 와!'라고 다정하게 말해주었습니다.
translations.pt: Meu amigo taiwanese me disse calorosamente: 'Apareça lá em casa sempre que estiver livre!'
translations.hi: मेरे ताइवानी दोस्त ने गर्मजोशी से कहा: 'जब भी समय मिले घर आया करो!'

en_full: Are you free this weekend? Let's go to a cafe together to study and chat.
grammar_tip: 台灣咖啡廳 (kā fēi tīng) are popular communal study spots with free Wi-Fi, power outlets, and peaceful music.

hanzi: 台灣朋友熱情地對我說：「有空常來家裡坐坐！」
pinyin: Tái wān péng yǒu rè qíng de duì wǒ shuō: 'Yǒu kòng cháng lái jiā lǐ zuò zuò!'
zhuyin: ㄊㄞˊ ㄨㄢ ㄆㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄖㄜˋ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄕㄨㄛ：ㄧㄡˇ ㄎㄨㄥˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄌㄞˊ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄗㄨㄛ˙！
tr_full: Tayvanlı arkadaşım bana sıcak bir şekilde: 'Vaktin olunca sık sık eve oturmaya gel!' dedi.
en_full: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'
grammar_tip: 有空來坐坐 (yǒu kòng lái zuò zuò = come sit whenever you have time) expresses classic Taiwanese hospitality.

translations.en: My Taiwanese friend warmly told me: 'Whenever you're free, come over to hang out!'
translations.es: Mi amigo taiwanés me dijo amablemente: '¡Cuando tengas tiempo, pásate por mi casa!'

grammar_tip: Red envelopes (紅包 hóng bāo) containing crisp new banknotes express auspicious blessings and longevity during Spring Festival.

translations.es: En Nochevieja lunar toda la familia se reúne para cenar, y los mayores reparten sobres rojos con dinero a los jóvenes.

translations.it: La vigilia del Capodanno lunare tutta la famiglia si riunisce per il banchetto e gli anziani donano le buste rosse ai più giovani.

grammar_tip: Hsinchu Science Park (竹科) houses TSMC (台積電), the world's most advanced chip foundry and Taiwan's 'Sacred Mountain Protecting the Nation' (護國神山).

grammar_tip: Taroko Gorge (太魯閣) in Hualien is sculpted by the Liwu River cutting deep into marble bedrock over millennia.

ja_full: 九份の古い街並みは山を背に海に面しており、赤い提灯が灯る夜景は特に魅惑的です。
ko_full: 지우펀 옛 거리는 산을 등지고 바다를 품고 있어, 붉은 홍등이 켜지는 야경이 무척 매혹적입니다.
pt_full: A rua antiga de Jiufen fica entre montanhas e o mar; quando as lanternas vermelhas se acendem, a vista é encantadora.
hi_full: जिउफेन पुरानी सड़क समुद्र के सामने पहाड़ों पर बसी है; लाल लालटेन जलने पर रात का दृश्य मनमोहक होता है।
